title: dForge Module Card Layouts
description: Module-shipped card (form) layouts for a dForge module package (ui/card_layouts.json). Each key is the layout_name stored in dForge.entity_view_layout. Rows written from here carry module_id, so they are recreated on every install and removed on uninstall; a layout the tenant drew in the card editor has module_id NULL and is never touched.

entity.description: Entity code the layout belongs to. Unqualified means this module owns the entity; the cross-module form 'module.entity' targets another module's entity (a bridge module shipping a layout for its host).

view.description: Entity view the layout hangs off, matching an entity_view row's view_name. Defaults to 'default' — the same fallback entity.getLayouts and entity.saveLayout use for an entity with no folder binding of its own. Matched against the entity's declared views case-insensitively, and filed under their spelling; the installer creates the view row only when nothing matches.

isDefault.description: Whether this layout opens by default. Honoured on FIRST install only, and only when the view has no default layout yet — once a tenant has chosen their own default, an upgrade does not take it back.

description.description: Human-readable note for the package author. Not stored.

layout.description: The layout body, stored verbatim into entity_view_layout.layout. Same shape the card editor saves.

sections.description: Ordered sections rendered down the card.

sets.description: Per-set-field view config, keyed by the set column code. Chooses the renderer a detail grid uses ('grid' or 'list') and its persisted options.

viewType.description: Set renderer. Defaults to the column's own metadata.

options.description: Opaque per-renderer options, passed verbatim to the set registration.

columnGroupSection.description: A group of fields laid out in 1, 2 or 3 columns.

code.description: Section code, unique within the layout.

label.description: Section heading, in the module's authoring language. The installer gives it an entity_column_group row keyed on this section's code, so translations/<locale>.json localizes it under entities.<entity>.columnGroups.<code>.label and the card shows the localized heading.

cols.description: Field columns across the group. Defaults to the card's own setting.

columns.description: Fields in the group, in render order. A bare string is the column code; the object form adds pixel sizing.

height.description: Field height in px — for multiline/textarea fields.

setSection.description: An embedded detail grid for a 1:N set column — the master/detail building block. The label comes from the column's own metadata.

code.description: Section code, unique within the layout.

setField.description: Set column code on this entity (columnType 'S').

tabGroupSection.description: A tab bar whose tabs are other sections. This is how a record shows several detail grids without stacking them down one long form.

code.description: Section code, unique within the layout.

tabs.description: Tabs in order. Each references a columnGroup section by its code, or a set column by its column code.

code.description: The referenced section's code, or the set column's code.
